A '''[[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]]''' [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] took part in the [[First Battle of Ruusan]] alongside another [[Unidentified Selkath Padawan (Force choke)|Selkath Padawan]] under a [[Unidentified Cerean Jedi|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. He was killed by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Kopecz]]'s [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], while the other Padawan was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|choked]] to death.<ref name="DBPoG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender/Legends|Gender]] of both Padawans is unknown. It is also unknown if they were the Padawans of the Cerean Master, or had just accompanied her.
